title: SKILL WARM-UP — raise · activate · skill prep · prime

rx.prescription:
RAISE: 2 min row, building.
ACTIVATE (2 rounds): 15 band pull-aparts · 8 scap pull-ups · 10 hollow rocks · 10s arch hold
SKILL PREP: 10s false-grip hang → 5 false-grip ring rows → 3 strict pull-ups (grease the pull for the muscle-ups)
PRIME: 5 Kang squats · 5 air squats (open the hips for the wall balls)
rx.target: greased & warm, never fatigued

title: OPENING NIGHT
classNote: 40-min running clock. Rig/rowers are 10 — run 2 heats if the class is full. Pick reps you can hold unbroken for all 10 rounds.

scaled.prescription:
Every 1 min for 40 min (4-station EMOM — 10 rounds):
Min 1 — 10/8 cal row
Min 2 — 8 ring rows
Min 3 — 16 wall balls 6/4kg to a lower target
Min 4 — 8 jumping pull-ups
scaled.target: every minute unbroken — scale reps to hold all 10 rounds

intermediate.prescription:
Every 1 min for 40 min (4-station EMOM — 10 rounds):
Min 1 — 12/10 cal row
Min 2 — 6 pull-ups
Min 3 — 16 wall balls 9/6kg
Min 4 — 5 chest-to-bar

rx.prescription:
Every 1 min for 40 min (4-station EMOM — 10 rounds):
Min 1 — 12/10 cal row
Min 2 — 6 strict pull-ups
Min 3 — 16 wall balls 9/6kg
Min 4 — 4 bar muscle-ups
rx.target: settle into a repeatable pace — every station unbroken across all 10 rounds

rxPlus.prescription:
